finalText:
Redis went down at 02:14:07 and never came back. When the cache layer dropped, every uncached request hit the database directly, triggering a cache miss storm across order keys. The store couldn't keep up — requests started timing out after 5 seconds. Queues backed up from 52 requests to 562+, and by 02:31 the heap ran out of memory trying to hold all that pending work. Worker-2 crashed, the API stopped responding, and the supervisor killed the whole thing.

Redis tried to reconnect 12 times and failed every time (address 10.0.0.12:6379). That's the thing to fix — either the Redis instance went down or the network path to it is broken. Once Redis is back, the cache layer recovers and the pile of backed-up requests drains normally.
